Class BuildingCardJson

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.common.BuildingCardJson
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardJson
public class BuildingCardJson extends Object implements CardJson
Java DTO class that maps the attributes of the buildings.json file to determine which type of effect to construct and, consequently, the entire building that depends on that effect, assigning the corresponding parameters for each effect type
